_comment: Copy to <your project>\.mcp.json. setup/36-ghidra-mcp.ps1 -WriteMcpConfigTo <dir> generates this for you with the paths already resolved. GHIDRA_MCP_URL is REQUIRED for the headless server: bridge discovery probes /mcp/instance_info, which only the Ghidra GUI plugin serves, so without this pin list_instances() finds nothing and no tools register. Drop it only if you are using the GUI.
